title: Mackerel Parcels
ingredients: grated   rind and juice of 1 orange
few   sprigs of parsley or coriander
method: After heading, gutting and cleaning fish season with salt and pepper.
Then mix butter until soft add the orange rind and juice mixing until smooth.
Add the garlic salt and onion mixing well.
Divide this into 4 portions and place inside each mackerel.
Place each fish on a large piece of greased foil and fold and crimp edges together to form a parcel over each fish making sure no juices can escape.
Place the parcels on a baking tin or casserole dish and bake for 30 minutes in a preheated oven at 350 deg F.
When cooked open parcels and decorate with orange pieces and parsley.
